title: ever COSTA|Deep V-Neck Lace Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress with Asymmetrical Hem
descriptionHtml:
A floral embroidered beauty! This sleeveless short dress features a deep V-neckline both front and back giving it a timeless glamour feel. The non-padded short party dress is accented with a gorgeous floral lace detailing as well as a ribbon on the waistband complimenting and accentuating the waistline. The asymmetric hem completes the look with a above the knee square towel skirt. These features create a flowy look and gives it a finishing touch making it the perfect dress to dance your night away! Wear it as a bridesmaid dress or a prom dress, your choice!

Fit: Please refer to Size Chart.


Closure: It is Concealed a Zipper Up The Back.


Undergarments: It is Padded, with Lining.


Fabric: Shell:100%Polyester, 
Lining:100%Polyester.


Stretch: Fabric is No Stretch.


Hem-length: Knee length/High-low.


Silhouette: A-line


Sleeve: Sleeveless


Neckline: Deep V-neck
